joules_per_flop.citation: From Tokens to Watt-hours (arXiv 2607.26571): tensor-core coefficient alpha_TC = 0.52 pJ/FLOP, H100 BF16

joules_per_hbm_bit.citation: From Tokens to Watt-hours (arXiv 2607.26571): HBM energy e_HBM = 11.68 pJ/bit, H100

overhead.citation: EcoLogits LLM inference methodology: non-GPU server power 1.2 kW per 8-GPU server, provider PUE 1.09-1.20

batch_size.citation: Assumption. EcoLogits fixes B=64; we bracket it. Larger batches amortize weight reads, so 128 is the low-energy end

weight_bits.citation: Assumption: FP8 to BF16 serving precision

kv_bits_per_token.citation: Assumption: 2 x layers x kv_heads x head_dim x bytes for GQA models (e.g. 80x8x128x2x2 bytes = 2.6 Mbit BF16); FP8/compressed caches are lower

prefill_inefficiency.citation: Assumption: static power and sub-peak utilization during prefill on top of pure FLOP energy

kv_reload_multiplier.citation: Assumption: a cache read is free if the prefix is still in HBM (low) or costs a reload from host memory at about 4x HBM read energy (high)

large.citation: Assumption: parameter counts are not disclosed for frontier closed models

mid.citation: Assumption: parameter counts are not disclosed for frontier closed models
